summary: Carlyle Private Equity Partners Fund, L.P. filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, reporting two events dated September 28, 2026. First, the Fund entered a letter agreement extending its Expense Support Period with Carlyle Investment Management through October 1, 2027, capping annual Specified Expenses at 0.60% of net assets. Second, the Fund sold unregistered limited partnership units on September 1, 2026, raising about $299.9 million across Classes E-A, E-I, S, I, and C. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are given. This is a routine advisory-fee support extension plus a private placement of fund units, not a special situation.
